Rice Blast (Magnaporthe oryzae)
Spindle-shaped elliptical lesions with grayish centers and dark brown margins.
Organic & Bio-Remedy
Spray fermented cow urine extract (10%) with turmeric powder or Pseudomonas fluorescens (5g/L).
Scientific Chemical Treatment
Tricyclazole 75% WP @ 0.6 g/L or Isoprothiolane 40% EC @ 1.5 ml/L at first appearance of spots.
Long-Term Preventive Measures
Avoid excessive urea/nitrogen applications which make foliage soft and succulent to fungal spores.
Always wear safety gloves and follow recommended pre-harvest intervals (PHI) when applying chemical sprays.
